title: Early Supply Run
description: You can still shop before shortages begin.

choices.label: Buy 5 days of supplies now
choices.consequence: You secure food and water before shelves thin out.

choices.label: Buy only basic supplies
choices.consequence: You reduce some risk but remain understocked.

choices.label: Delay shopping
choices.consequence: You risk shortages and panic buying later.

title: Scooter and Property Protection
description: Flooding could damage uncovered transport and valuables.

choices.label: Move scooter to safe storage and secure documents
choices.consequence: You reduce flood damage and secure critical paperwork.

choices.label: Secure documents only
choices.consequence: Documents are safer, but scooter remains exposed.

choices.label: Do nothing
choices.consequence: Exposure remains high as flood risk increases.

title: Home Protection
description: You can reinforce entry points and secure important documents.

choices.label: Reinforce home and secure documents
choices.consequence: You reduce household exposure and improve readiness.

choices.label: Do basic reinforcement
choices.consequence: You reduce some risk but leave weak points.

choices.label: Skip protection
choices.consequence: No additional mitigation is in place.

title: Work Shift vs Preparation
description: You can work extra hours or spend the time preparing.

choices.label: Skip shift and prepare
choices.consequence: You sacrifice income for better readiness.

choices.label: Work the shift
choices.consequence: You gain cash but lose preparation time.

title: Insurance Verification
description: Verify your policy and gather claim-ready documentation.

choices.label: Verify policy and take inventory photos
choices.consequence: You improve claim readiness and reduce uncertainty.

choices.label: Skip verification
choices.consequence: Coverage details remain unclear.

title: Evacuation Decision
description: Road conditions are worsening. Decide your response.

choices.label: Evacuate before roads congest
choices.consequence: You move to safer ground before peak risk.

choices.label: Move to nearby shelter
choices.consequence: You reduce risk but remain near storm impacts.

choices.label: Stay in place
choices.consequence: You remain in the highest-risk zone.

title: Landfall Response
description: Peak storm arrives. Your immediate behavior matters.

choices.label: Follow strict emergency protocol
choices.consequence: You minimize avoidable risk during peak impact.

choices.label: Take unplanned reactive actions
choices.consequence: Reactive choices increase exposure and losses.

choices.label: Document damage and start recovery plan
choices.consequence: Structured recovery reduces long-term disruption.

choices.label: Delay recovery actions
choices.consequence: Delays increase preventable setbacks.
